lemmas.name: findproduct_post
lemmas.statement: ∀ (lst : List Int) (h : findProduct_precond lst), findProduct_postcond lst (match firstEvenOddIndices lst with | some (ei, oi) => lst[ei]! * lst[oi]! | none => 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst h
  unfold findProduct_postcond
  cases hf : firstEvenOddIndices lst with
  | none => simp
  | some p => obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p; simp
